The report mentions no casualties. The 2002 farm is not in the farm layer (only a new 2027 project is), so no farm is linked.

summary: 運轉 19 年的 72×2.3 MW 風場 1 月 12 日一部 110 公尺高風機脫網後翻倒，隔天才發現機組連同混凝土重力式基礎（合計約 2,050 噸）都倒在海中，當時無人在場、無人受傷；8 月 Ørsted 在另一部風機基礎發現裂縫、一併停機，能源署 5 月 11 日核准拆除 A02（ens.dk；Maritimedanmark 2022-01-14；ing.dk 2022-08-09）。

On 12 January a 110 m turbine at the 19-year-old 72 × 2.3 MW farm dropped off the grid and was found the next day lying in the sea together with its concrete gravity-base foundation (about 2,050 t in all); nobody was present or hurt. In August Ørsted found cracks in another foundation and stopped that turbine too; the Danish Energy Agency approved the removal of A02 on 11 May 2022 (ens.dk; Maritimedanmark 14 Jan 2022; ing.dk 9 Aug 2022).

summary: 1 月 4 日 Zeewolde 市 Eemmeerdijk 風場一部風機的上半段折斷，轉子、葉片與塔頂掉到堤防道路上，無人受傷；Vattenfall 隨即停下沿堤其餘 16 部風機，風場原已排定年內拆除。荷蘭基礎設施與水管理部 2023-10-17 致國會函引述 Vattenfall 委託的外部調查：維修中一個變槳油缸被固定，葉片無法順槳，強風下轉速過高、劇烈振動而失穩，機械煞車擋不住；老化、維修不足與金屬疲勞都不是原因。機組 1998 年安裝，為已倒閉 NedWind 製造的雙葉風機，荷蘭已無同型變槳系統的風機在運轉。

On 4 January the upper part of a turbine at the Eemmeerdijk wind farm in Zeewolde broke off; rotor, blades and tower top fell onto the dyke road and nobody was hurt. Vattenfall stopped the other 16 turbines along the dyke at once; the farm was already due for dismantling that year. The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management's letter to parliament of 17 Oct 2023 cites the external investigation commissioned by Vattenfall: a pitch cylinder had been fixed during maintenance so the blades could not feather, the rotor overspeeded in strong wind and the turbine became unstable through violent vibration, which the mechanical brake could not stop; ageing, deferred maintenance and metal fatigue played no role. The turbines were installed in 1998 by the now-defunct NedWind (two-blade machines) and no turbine with such a pitch system still operates in the Netherlands.
